entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: I won't let you get in the way!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Joker, let's try talking to her. Maybe we[n]can calm her down!
By [clr 2]weakening[clr 27] the enemy, you will be able to[n]speak to them.
By choosing the correct answers, you will be able[n]to change the target's heart.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: I'm gonna make everyone pay!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What!? She just healed herself!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey Joker, let's see if we can calm her[n]down! It might be easier to change her[n]heart that way!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay! Looks like we can talk to her now![n]Let's try and get through to her!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We aren't getting anywhere like this...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Looks like we'll have to weaken her a[n]little more!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: What the hell did I ever do to Shiho!?
You spat on her.
You tore apart her things.
You made fun of her.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: It's her fault Mr. Kamoshida can't teach us[n]anymore! She's getting what she deserves!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: See!? You don't know anything!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Looks like we couldn't convince her! We[n]might need to think of something else.
Stop complaining.
The volleyball team is done.
You were close with him.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: What the hell are you talking about!?[n]You know nothing about me!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But... I do know.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shiho told me that you're the one she[n]trusts the most on the volleyball team.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: You know nothing about me!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Looks like we couldn't convince her! We[n]might need to think of something else.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: I trusted Shiho too...

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: And when she attempted suicide, I was[n]so upset that I couldn't do anything to[n]help.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: Sure, Mr. Kamoshida did terrible things[n]to her... But that didn't matter to me.
Because you hated him.
You admired him.
You loved him.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: I came to Shujin just because I wanted to be[n]on the volleyball team. Learning under[n]Mr. Kamoshida was a dream come true.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: I became friends with Shiho, and I got[n]to compete alongside teammates I could[n]trust...

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: I was starting to believe we could even[n]win the nationals...

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: All of this... It's all Shiho's fault!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: That's not true! You don't know anything!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Looks like we couldn't convince her! We[n]might need to think of something else.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You were jealous of Shiho, weren't you?

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: Me...? Jealous of Shiho?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You were envious of Shiho because[n]the teacher you admired only ever[n]acknowledged her.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: Ugh... It is true that Mr. Kamoshida only[n]paid attention to Shiho. He never even[n]tried to coach me...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You were suffering... and so was[n]the person you were jealous of.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You weren't the only person who felt[n]betrayed by someone you admired.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But even despite everything, Shiho is still[n]trying to keep moving forward.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: Ngh...

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: She was the one who had it rough... and I...

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: Why do I have to talk about anything!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Saeki
entries.en: I have nothing to say to you!
